package.name: alterego_mimic
package.description: Person following for AlterEgo v2 with a RealSense on the head. person_tracker (robot base PC, conda, YOLOv8-pose) publishes the person's 2D and 3D keypoints, torso position and face direction. person_follower keeps the distance, looks at the face, turns the base when the neck reaches its limit and mimics the arms. A browser GUI runs a built-in simulation or monitors and commands the real robot.
